metadata.scenario: A patient calls frustrated because she left two voicemails last week about getting her care plan updated and nobody called back. She says this isn't the first time she's been ignored. The receptionist apologizes and promises to have the care coordinator call her today.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Robert Jackson. I’m really frustrated because I left two voicemails last week about updating my care plan, and nobody called me back. I'm so sorry to hear that, Robert. That’s definitely not the service we aim to provide. This isn't the first time! I feel like I've been ignored, and it’s really concerning. I completely understand your frustration, and I apologize for the oversight. Let me make sure we address this right away. Thank you, but I really need this sorted out. My neurologist provided specific care instructions, and they need to be followed. Absolutely, those instructions are crucial. I’ll have our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, call you today to discuss the updates. I appreciate that. It’s just been a bit overwhelming managing my care on top of everything else. I can imagine. We’re here to help lighten that load. Is there anything else you'd like us to focus on when Lisa calls? Yes, I’d also like to inquire about additional personal care assistance. It’s been challenging lately, and I could use some more help. I can definitely relay that to Lisa. She’ll go over the options we have for personal care assistance during her call. That sounds good. I just want to make sure everything is in order—I feel like I’m chasing my own care. That’s understandable, Robert. We’ll ensure that you have a dedicated plan. I’ll make a note for Lisa to prioritize your care plan and personal assistance needs. Thank you, Margaret. I really hope this gets resolved quickly. You’re welcome. I will follow up personally if I don’t hear from Lisa by the end of the day. That would be great. I just need reassurance that someone is on top of this. Absolutely, and I appreciate your patience with us. Your care is our priority. Thank you again, Margaret. I’ll look out for Lisa’s call. Thank you for calling, Robert. Have a great day ahead! You too, bye! Goodbye!
